purpose: Safety gate for imported image sprites; no asset is approved as an interchangeable animated layer without manual visual validation.
observations: All 81 WebP assets are committed and addressed at stable paths.
Spot-check confirms that equal 512×768 canvases do not imply matching body/head/feet anchor coordinates.
Hair sprite crops contain adjacent artwork or mismatched view labels; cannot safely use them as changeable hair during walking.
Keep the existing fitted Atelier layers and protected Sanctuary Guardian renderer until new layers pass visual registration.
